commands: git pull -q --ff-only origin integration && git log --oneline -3
git add tally/rounding.py && git commit -q -m "Round half points up to a whole point"

cat > tests/test_rounding.py <<'EOF'
from tally.rounding import rounded_points


def test_half_points_are_rounded_up():
    assert [rounded_points(p) for p in (7.0, 7.5, 8.4)] == [7, 8, 8]
EOF
python -m pytest -q tests/test_rounding.py && git add tests/test_rounding.py && git commit -q -m "Test the rounding of half points"
git push -q origin integration && git log --oneline -2 origin/integration
